meta.name: Validate Belgian VAT numbers and Peppol status with VIES and the Peppol API

name: Validate Belgian VAT numbers and check Peppol e-invoicing status

parameters.content:
## Belgian client check: VAT number and Peppol status

Enter a Belgian VAT or enterprise number and get back whether it is valid, who it belongs to, and whether that company can receive e-invoices over Peppol.

### Setup

Nothing to configure. VIES and the Peppol Directory are public services: no API key, no account, no credentials.

Click **Execute workflow**, open the test form URL on the trigger node and enter `BE 0203.201.340`. You should get a company name, address and Peppol status back.

To use the form permanently, activate the workflow and share the production URL.

### Good to know

Since 1 January 2026, B2B invoices in Belgium travel over Peppol. Send one to a company that is not registered and it never arrives, with no error on your side.

Both HTTP nodes continue on error, so an outage returns "not found" instead of failing the run.

The Peppol Directory allows two queries per second. Add a Wait node when checking a whole list.

## Input and normalization

Strips formatting, pads old nine-digit numbers with a leading zero and runs the mod-97 checksum used by Belgian enterprise numbers.

## VAT and Peppol lookups

Validates the VAT number against VIES, then searches the Peppol Directory twice: under scheme 0208 (enterprise number) and 9925 (VAT number).

Belgian companies register under either one, so searching a single scheme produces false negatives.

## Report and result

Combines the three sources into one plain-language verdict and shows it on the form's completion page.
